title: Snapshot crafts
description: Makes items craftable on their first snapshot added
body:
This mod makes every item craftable in Minecraft snapshots when they were first added.

**Items added at the moment:**

- Makes spyglass craftable in first snapshot it was added
- Makes brush have the newest craft when first added
